_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recording of any site.
Page 2 of the same feed as feed.json, at offset 4. Together the two prove
that Chapters() pages with offset until it has reached total, rather than
silently returning the first page and calling it a chapter list — which is
the failure mode a long-running series would hit and a short one would not.
Deliberate variations exercised by the test:
- a oneshot with no chapter number at all, whose parsed Number must be
-1 (theme.Chapter documents that) and whose title must not read
- a chapter marked isUnavailable, listed by the site but not servable
